item.text: {"analysis":"The trial crashed with a nonzero training-process exit after 5.28 allocated GPU-seconds. No validation score was returned. The host traceback shows only CalledProcessError, so the underlying exception and whether pretraining diagnostics completed remain unknown. Relaxing CUDA convolution diagnostic tolerances and adding category context did not establish a successful run; there is no evidence of improved recommendation quality.","code_summary":"One independently trained model per category combines a 3-layer, 64-dimensional LightGCN with gated history attention over the latest 128 events. The history encoder includes relative-position embeddings, a latest-item query projection, and a causal width-3 convolution with a zero-initialized output projection. Training uses prefix targets, minibatch supervised-edge removal with graph renormalization, sampled-negative cross-entropy, and embedding regularization. Validation selects one checkpoint per category. The predictor writer restores that architecture and exactly one selected checkpoint for each of the four dataset routes; no ensemble or separately fitted scorer is used."}
